Q: I was charged twice for the same order, what should I do?
A: Duplicate charges are usually auto-reversed within 5-7 business days; if not, contact billing support with your order ID for a manual refund.

Q: How long does a refund take to process?
A: Refunds typically take 5-7 business days to reflect, depending on your bank or payment provider.

Q: What payment methods does ShopUNow accept?
A: We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and popular digital wallets at checkout.

Q: Why was my payment declined?
A: Payments can decline due to insufficient funds, bank-side restrictions, or incorrect card details; please retry or try an alternate payment method.

Q: How do I get a copy of my invoice?
A: Invoices are available under "My Orders > Order Details > Download Invoice" in your account, or can be emailed on request.

Q: I was overcharged compared to the listed price, can I get the difference refunded?
A: Yes, please share the order ID and a screenshot of the listed price; verified overcharges are refunded within 3-5 business days.

Q: Can I change my payment method after placing an order?
A: Payment methods cannot be changed after an order is placed, but you can cancel the order and reorder with your preferred method if it hasn't shipped.

Q: Do you store my card details?
A: We don't store raw card numbers; payments are processed via PCI-compliant gateways using tokenized card details.

Q: How do I apply a discount coupon that didn't work at checkout?
A: Check the coupon's validity and minimum order value; if it should have applied, contact billing support with the coupon code and order ID.

Q: Can I get a GST/tax invoice for my purchase?
A: Yes, GST invoices are automatically generated for eligible orders and can be downloaded from "My Orders".

Q: My refund amount doesn't match what I paid, why?
A: This can happen if a partial item was returned or a coupon discount was deducted; the order summary breaks down the exact refundable amount.

Q: How do I set up an EMI payment option?
A: EMI is available on select cards and order values above the EMI threshold; eligible options are shown automatically at checkout.
